crops.reading: Blue dome; orange line across the face at the screen's top, carried round the corners; one black surround with two panes and a thin centre pillar; LED destination display in the top of the image-left pane; wipers pivoted low near the centre, parked flat along each pane's bottom; yellow panel (middle section framed by seams); thin blue then orange strip under it; deep red lower front with a large coupler recess, steps, '456004' in white each side.

crops.feature: roof dome and orange line over the screens
crops.reading: Domed blue roof end, the orange line along the screen top.

crops.feature: windscreen: two panes in one black surround, destination display, wipers
crops.reading: Two equal panes in one black surround, pillar near the centre; display behind the glass, top of the left pane.

crops.feature: yellow panel, raised middle section, blue and orange strips under it
crops.reading: Yellow panel full width under the screens, black handrails along its top, middle section a separate framed panel, blue and orange strips below curving back round the corners.
Yellow screwed plate: headlamp outboard (left), red LED cluster inboard.
Mirror: red LED cluster inboard (left), headlamp outboard.

crops.feature: red lower front: numbers, coupler recess, steps
crops.reading: Red lower front: coupler in a deep recess, footsteps either side, white numbers.
Close from the left: middle yellow panel stands proud of the sides; screen surround near vertical above it; LED inboard lit red.
Headlamp outboard unlit, LED inboard lit red.

crops.feature: front three-quarter from the right, close
crops.reading: From the right, close: same layout; the middle panel framed by seams.

crops.feature: cab side: cab door with drop light, short window, sweep
crops.reading: From the front: cab corner, cab door (narrow, a tall drop-light window), a narrow short window, then a full window; blue covers the cab door; the orange band crosses its rear lower corner.

crops.feature: cab corner, cab door, short window, window and door 1
crops.reading: Cab door, short window (about half the next window's width), full window, door 1.
Blue leaves with narrow tall round-topped windows; yellow surround on the body, carried over the top; step plate.
Door 2, oblique; the orange waist line runs to its far edge.

crops.feature: windows between the doors and ahead of door 1
crops.reading: Paired windows with top hoppers between the doors; one window ahead of door 1.
White arrow + 'South Western Railway', between doors 1 and 2 under the windows.
Thin orange line below the windows, meeting door 2's surround.

crops.feature: second car (DTSO): doors, windows, line, wordmark
crops.reading: Second car: wordmark between its doors, an orange line below the windows from its inner end to the wordmark.
Side on at Kingston (456 + 455): red bodysides, yellow surrounds, wordmark lettering.
SWR-era diagram, the Unisouth template: SWR wordmark between doors 1 and 2, orange line behind it.
Raked upper face over an upright lower nose and deep skirt; blue cab end, orange band, red below; hinged cab door drawn close behind the nose.
